registry.hypothesis: Positions implied by the frozen climate conditions earn no more, after costs, than holding the same targets, and no more than the drift of each target explains.
registry.benchmarks: same targets held long at the same weights over the same windows; SPY; drift-adjusted excess (position return minus the target's own mean daily return since 2013, signed by the position)
registry.evidence_of_edge: At a review: positive net annualised return, positive drift-adjusted excess, positive beta-adjusted alpha against SPY, and positive in both halves. Otherwise no evidence of an edge.
registry.history: The same rule on causally admitted rows (2016-2026) returned -1.4% a year in the extreme tail (Sharpe -0.08) and -2.4% a year for all admitted rows; see the backtest panel. The live record is the test.
registry.not_claimed: No significance test is used, positions are paper positions, and a null result does not show that no edge exists anywhere.

backtest.rule: one vote per (target, direction) from the next row for the row horizon; opposite votes cancel; equal weight over active targets; 10 bp per unit of turnover; admission re-decided on 1 January each year from resolved outcomes only
backtest.window: entries 2016-2026 (admission needs 3 resolved test episodes, so the first admissions are in 2016)

curves.basis: primary arm: climate = extreme tail (q_X >= 0.9) admitted rows; market = all admitted rows
